name: Bitcoin
source: https://bitcoin.org/img/icons/logotop.svg (the bitcoin.org header logo; the footer's https://bitcoin.org/img/icons/logo-footer.svg draws the same mark)
notes: Circle: the symbol of logotop.svg, its #F7931A disc and white ₿ paths unchanged, full-bleed on the 64 grid

Default: the same ₿ path alone in the disc's #F7931A. bitcoin.org shows the ₿ only on the disc, so the bare glyph is this repository's composition; it stays the base because docs/icon-variants.md uses Bitcoin / BitcoinCircle as its example of a standalone base with a Circle variant
Mono: the bare ₿ in currentColor; CircleMono: the disc in currentColor with the ₿ knocked out (fill-rule=evenodd)
